decisions.statement: The run drawn is the story's played turns, or its chapters where it has no turn.
The rows drawn are the rows naming this story and no other.
Nothing is drawn until the rows of the story have arrived.
A story with no turn and no chapter of its own draws nothing at all.
A game that went unread is said so above the run rather than passed over.
The panels sit in a drawer on a narrow screen and beside the run on a wide one.
Nothing here polls, and no tagline is drawn, because this play takes no action.

definition: the display a story played draws over its own play, with the game's panels
